payload.note: A four-dimensional plaquette absorption inequality now proves Hess A[h,h]>=(2/9)*N*omega_L^2 for every background, every L>=4, and every phase/axis of a lowest mode. Thus Var(t|eta)<=9/(2*N*omega_L^2) uniformly in the orthogonal background: the all-background recentered-width gate is closed. The remaining lowest-mode gate is the Gibbs-weighted second moment of the unique conditional centers, followed by the integrated marginal, Fourier shells, interacting H^-1, and continuum reconstruction.
